1002|S. Leodegarii Ep. et Mart.|pc.en_full: You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of her whose feast we celebrate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

1007|S. Marci Papæ et Conf.|se.en_full: Let Your saints, O Lord, everywhere make us glad; that while we remember their merits we may experience their help; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

1025|SS. Crispini et Crispiniani MM.|se.en_full: We offer You, O Lord, the gifts of our devotion, that they may be pleasing to You for the honor of Your saints and, by Your mercy, become salutary to us; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

1108|SS. Quatuor Coronatorum MM.|or.en_full: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we who have known the glorious martyrs to be steadfast in their confession may feel them to be loving intercessors for us with You; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

1108|SS. Quatuor Coronatorum MM.|se.en_full: May Your blessing, O Lord, come down abundantly, that, Your holy martyrs pleading, it may make our gifts acceptable to You and make for us the sacrament of redemption; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

1108|SS. Quatuor Coronatorum MM.|pc.en_full: Refreshed with heavenly sacraments and joys, we humbly pray You, O Lord, that we may be protected by the help of those in whose triumphs we glory; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

1114|S. Britii Ep. et Conf.|se.en_full: Let Your saints, O Lord, everywhere make us glad; that while we remember their merits we may experience their help; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

1124|S. Chrysogoni Mart.|pc.en_full: By receiving Your sacrament, O Lord, may we be cleansed of our secret sins and delivered from the snares of our enemies. Through Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

1204|S. Barbaræ Virg. et Mart.|se.en_full: May the offering of Your consecrated people be acceptable to You, O Lord, in honor of Your saints, through whose merits they acknowledge that they have received help in tribulation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

1204|S. Barbaræ Virg. et Mart.|pc.en_full: You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of her whose feast we celebrate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

0102|Octava S. Stephani Protomartyris|se.en_full: Receive, O Lord, these gifts in commemoration of Your saints, that, as their passion made them glorious, so our devotion may make us blameless; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

0102|Octava S. Stephani Protomartyris|pc.en_full: May the mysteries we have received help us, O Lord, and, by the intercession of blessed Stephen Your martyr, strengthen us with everlasting protection; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

0103|Octava S. Joannis Ap. et Ev.|or.en_full: O Lord, graciously shed light upon Your Church, so that, enlightened by the teachings of blessed John, Your Apostle and Evangelist, she may gain Your everlasting rewards. Through Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

0103|Octava S. Joannis Ap. et Ev.|pc.en_full: Refreshed with this heavenly food and drink, O our God, we humbly pray that we may be helped by the prayers of him in whose memory we have received it; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

0115|S. Pauli primi Eremitæ Conf.|pc.en_full: Refreshed with heavenly food and drink, O our God, we humbly entreat You that we may also be defended by the prayers of her in whose commemoration we have received these gifts; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

0118|S. Priscæ Virg. et Mart.|pc.en_full: Filled with saving mysteries, we beseech You, O Lord, that we may be helped by the prayers of her whose feast we celebrate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

0127|S. 0127|S. Juliani Ep. et Conf.|pc.en_full: Grant to Your faithful, we beseech You, O Lord, ever to rejoice in the veneration of Your saints, and to be fortified by their unceasing prayer; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

0128|S. Agnetis secundo|pc.en_full: We have received, O Lord, the votive sacraments of this yearly feast; grant, we beseech You, that they may bring us remedies both for this temporal life and for eternal life; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

0428|S. Pauli a Cruce Conf.|or.en_full: O Lord Jesus Christ, who endowed saint Paul with singular charity to preach the mystery of the Cross, and willed that through him a new family should flourish in the Church, grant us by his intercession that, ever recalling Your passion on earth, we may deserve to obtain its fruit in heaven; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

0428|S. Pauli a Cruce Conf.|se.en_full: May these mysteries, O Lord, give us that fervor for Your passion and death with which saint Paul, in offering them, presented his body to You as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to You; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

0428|S. Pauli a Cruce Conf.|pc.en_full: We have received, O Lord, the divine sacrament, the everlasting memorial of Your boundless charity; grant, we beseech You, that by the merits and example of saint Paul we may draw from Your fountains water springing up into life eternal, and may hold fast in our conduct and life Your most sacred passion impressed upon our hearts; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

0702|SS. Processi et Martiniani MM.|pc.en_full: Filled with the draught of the sacred Body and precious Blood, we beseech You, O Lord our God, that what we perform with loving devotion we may receive as sure redemption; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

0814|S. Eusebii Presb. et Conf.|se.en_full: We offer You, O Lord, victims of praise in memory of Your saints; and trust thereby to be freed from all ills both present and to come; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

0814|S. 0817|Octava S. Laurentii|or.en_full: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, to extinguish the flames of our sins, as You granted St. Lawrence to overcome the fires of his tortures. Through Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

0817|Octava S. Laurentii|se.en_full: Receive, we beseech You, O Lord, the gifts fully offered to You, and, by the interceding merits of blessed Lawrence, Your Martyr, grant they may further our salvation. Through Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

0817|Octava S. Laurentii|pc.en_full: Filled with Your sacred gifts, we humbly pray You, O Lord, that as we perform this sacred act in duty bound, we may, through the intercession of Your blessed Martyr Lawrence, enjoy an increase of Your saving grace. Through Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

0818|S. Agapiti Mart.|pc.en_full: You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of her whose feast we celebrate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

0822|SS. Timothei et Symphoriani MM.|se.en_full: May the offering of Your consecrated people be acceptable to You, O Lord, in honor of Your saints, through whose merits they acknowledge that they have received help in tribulation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

0904|Octava S. Augustini|or.en_full: Hearken to our supplications, almighty God, and, blessed Augustine, Your confessor and bishop, interceding, graciously grant the effect of Your wonted mercy to those to whom You give confidence to hope for Your loving-kindness; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

0904|Octava S. Augustini|se.en_full: May the loving prayer of Your holy confessor and bishop Augustine not fail us, O Lord, that it may make our gifts acceptable and ever obtain for us Your pardon; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

0904|Octava S. Augustini|pc.en_full: That Your sacrifices may give us salvation, O Lord, may blessed Augustine, Your confessor and bishop, we beseech You, come forward as our advocate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

0916|S. Euphemiæ Virg. et Mart.|pc.en_full: Refreshed with heavenly food and drink, O our God, we humbly entreat You that we may also be defended by the prayers of her in whose commemoration we have received these gifts; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

0917|S. Lamberti Ep. et Mart.|se.en_full: May this victim, we beseech You, O Lord, cleanse our sins, and sanctify the bodies and minds of Your servants for the offering of this sacrifice; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
